method: Handwritten symbolic derivations in the review; file-handling and hashing only in the terminal. No executed mathematical computations, candidate trials, numerical experiments, or parameter sweeps.

claims.reason: gcd-testing raw residues gives uniform units; proper nonunits exit, full nonunits retry/exhaust; pay both random-bit and residue rejection.

K accepted units are not K raw draws. Raw beta=(p+q-2)/N; before K units raw-only success=1-(M/(N-1))^K, still <=K(1/p+1/q) by a separate stopped-process proof. Expected virtual raw draws=KN/M. P's word only must qualify the raw-draw derivation, not deny this numerical probability upper bound.
Unique root for each edge when H<p; no pair-event independence assumed; collision gate KH^2=Omega(p) is necessary.

claims.claim: Primitive factor identity and unit constants
claims.reason: Unique (i,j)=g(a,b); m=floor(H/max(a,b)); C is product of gcds, equivalently product of m!; g and a units on H<p.

claims.claim: Preservation of proper edges and masking
claims.reason: Edge gcds are unchanged by unit g. Aggregate full gcd does not itself certify failure or expose a proper edge; tags and paid localization are necessary.
Shell count with phi(1)=1; common-divisor union bound and strict integral comparison prove H^2/4<d_H<=H^2 without asymptotic totient estimates.
Explicit gcd enumeration is O(H^2 poly(log(2H))); Farey output still has d_H records; no prime/totient oracle or free inverses.
Nonzero cross-difference has absolute value <=H^2-1<p<q; each component hits at most one primitive tag.
Independent unit components give d^2/M both hits; d/M are same-tag failures; d(d-1)/M distinct-tag hits are recoverable.
Fixed-H iid accepted draws have the stated law, including accidental duplicates. Deliberate repeats, filtering, deduplication/resampling and failure conditioning need separate laws.

claims.claim: H=1, p=2, H^2=p, H=p and p=q boundaries
claims.reason: H=1 and p=2 pass symbolically; H^2=p is impossible for integer H and prime p; H=p loses the unit premise; prime-square CRT substitution is invalid.
Record traffic is Omega(KH); necessary KH^2 gate implies sqrt(p) scale; streaming does not refund traffic.
Unit leading coefficients preserve degrees H^2 and d=Theta(H^2); dense construction plus K queries is soft H^2+K with paid width factors; localization is additional.
One tagged-tree descent is valid in no-alias range. Outside it, scan/prune all global zeros or use the original excluded-row consumer; arbitrary full-child descent may miss useful siblings.
Only these representations/generator are gated; no circuit lower bound or all-input factoring theorem; W007 supply obligation is prior internal work; W032 untouched; improvement NONE.
